evidence: Modifies secondary index declarations in `src/index/`, moves index ownership out of global variables, and establishes `src/node/indexes` to decouple index libraries from `NodeContext`.
rationale: The PR removes process-global index singletons and encapsulates their lifecycle in `NodeContext`. This advances the decoupling of the index framework from node internals and unblocks multiprocess node encapsulation, though it introduces no direct bug fixes or user-facing changes.
